profiles.summary: Use bounded repo-owned Planning records plus worktree-local owner selection; do not rely on native runtime artifacts.
profiles.sync_rule: Bounded owner and relation records stay authoritative; current selection and aggregate queue or roadmap views remain local or derived.
profiles.handoff_rule: Use bounded repo-owned Planning records directly for restart, review, and cross-agent continuation.

profiles.summary: Allow Gemini-style native workflow artifacts as runtime scratchpads, but project durable state back into repo-owned planning before handoff or review.
profiles.sync_rule: Before review, handoff, or session end, mirror durable execution facts into the bounded owner and relation records instead of leaving them only in native artifacts.
profiles.handoff_rule: Treat native artifacts and current-owner selection as local execution aids; treat bounded checked-in Planning records as cross-agent truth.
